variants.name: 柔宋花笺
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: typography design preview for Cecilia's QQ /help image menu, portrait 1024x1536.
Input images in order: 1 is Cecilia's calm expression, 2 is her shy expression, 3 is her gentle smiling expression. These three are CHARACTER AND PERSONALITY REFERENCES only, showing one same girl: soft pale ash-blonde hair with sage tint, gray-green eyes, tender shy warmth. Image 4 is the EXISTING BACKGROUND AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE; use this ivory floral stationery with restrained gold border, sage leaves and upper-right Cecilia bust, preserving its visual feeling and large clean central area.
Primary request: create a beautifully designed finished Chinese help-card typography reference with lettering specifically suited to this girl's personality and the provided background. The user rejected both rigid office typography and excessively flowing cursive. Design a convincing middle ground, artistically drawn Chinese lettering with subtle personality, readable and harmonious. Typography is the focus; do not radically redesign the background or add character figures. Keep the upper-right portrait small and preserve her identity from references.
Layout: top-left small '/help', then large title '指令手册', portrait upper-right. Below the portrait in the spacious middle area, eight elegant ivory menu tiles in TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS with generous margins. Each tile has one category label in expressive display lettering and one simple, highly readable smaller command line. Use quiet thin borders and avoid heavy boxes. Category labels should share the title's typography character, slightly more restrained. Commands are supporting information with clean gentle legibility.
Text (verbatim):
Header: '/help'
Title: '指令手册'
Row 1 left: '模型' with '/help 模型'; right: '角色' with '/help 角色'.
Row 2 left: '回复' with '/help 回复'; right: '群聊' with '/help 群聊'.
Row 3 left: '养成' with '/help 养成'; right: '材料' with '/help 材料'.
Row 4 left: '权限' with '/help 权限'; right: '插件' with '/help 插件'.
Footer two short lines: '群聊先 @ 目标 Bot' and '文字版 /help 文字'.
Constraints: exactly this content, accurate readable simplified Chinese; no invented prose, no duplicated labels, no explanations, no style name or variant marker on the artwork. No watermarks, no 3D mockups. Typography must look thoughtfully drawn rather than a default system font. Keep each Chinese glyph clearly separate; absolutely no connected cursive, no long flourishes, no flamboyant swashes, no chaotic skew, no techno font, no childlike bubble font, no exaggerated gold foil or chunky drop shadow. The artwork should feel like a gentle girl's personal stationery, not an office dashboard.
Typography direction A — soft literary serif lettering: original Chinese display letterforms inspired by a gentle illustrated storybook and refined soft Song type. Delicate but confident thick-thin stroke contrast, subtle curved terminals, softened corners, slightly organic proportions rather than a rigid grid. Main lettering in deep muted sage green with a barely visible warm-ivory edge highlight and a hairline warm-gold offset accent. Light character spacing, moderate weight, excellent readability. The result should be refined, warm and quietly artistic, without looking like printed textbook Song or historical calligraphy. Small commands in warm taupe.
